title: Right to Life
description: Interpreted by courts to include the right to a healthy environment; basis for forest and pollution PILs (e.g. T.N. Godavarman Thirumulpad v. Union of India).

title: Equality & Reservation
description: Basis for prosecutions where fraudulent caste certificates were used to claim reserved seats, posts, or benefits.

title: Forest Clearance
description: Requires central government approval before forest land is diverted to non-forest use; diversion without approval is the basis for illegal-felling cases.

title: Anti-Corruption
description: Covers bribery and criminal misconduct by public servants; basis for chargesheets in bureaucratic corruption cases.

title: Cheating
description: Commonly invoked in paper-leak and fraudulent-certificate prosecutions.

title: Right to Information
description: Primary statutory mechanism used to obtain the government records cited on this site.

title: Anti-Monopoly / Fair Trade
description: Governs Competition Commission of India (CCI) findings on market dominance and anti-competitive conduct; only CCI/court findings are cited here, not market-share commentary.
